title: Fleet health
description: Host, RAID and disk health of every server that sends metrics: the monitoring host and the servers running the host agent

panels.title: Servers reporting
panels.description: Servers whose node_exporter answered its last scrape

panels.title: Silent servers
panels.description: Servers that sent nothing for 15 minutes, within the last day

panels.title: Disks failing SMART
panels.description: Failed overall health, or any NVMe critical warning bit, which these disks set once worn out

targets.expr: count(max by (host, device) (smartctl_device_smart_status{host=~"$host"} == 0 or smartctl_device_critical_warning{host=~"$host"} > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Servers
panels.description: One row per server. Colours follow the alert rules' thresholds.

targets.expr: count by (host) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", host=~"$host"}) or count by (host) (up{host=~"$host"}) * 0

panels.title: Storage
panels.description: One row per server: RAID arrays, disks and boot code. A blank cell means the server doesn't report that metric.

targets.expr: count by (host) (node_md_disks_required{host=~"$host"} - ignoring(state) node_md_disks{state="active", host=~"$host"} > 0) or count by (host) (node_md_disks_required{host=~"$host"}) * 0

count by (host) (max by (host, device) (smartctl_device_smart_status{host=~"$host"} == 0 or smartctl_device_critical_warning{host=~"$host"} > 0)) or max by (host) (smartctl_devices{host=~"$host"}) * 0

max by (host) (max by (host, device) (smartctl_device_percentage_used{host=~"$host"}) or (100 - min by (host, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Percent_Lifetime_Remain|Wear_Leveling_Count|Media_Wearout_Indicator", attribute_value_type="value", host=~"$host"})))

sum by (host) (max by (host, device) (smartctl_device_media_errors{host=~"$host"}) or sum by (host, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Reported_Uncorrect|Current_Pending_Sector|Offline_Uncorrectable", attribute_value_type="raw", host=~"$host"}))

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: One row per disk, as smartctl names it. Wear is the share of the disk's rated endurance used, and can pass 100%.

targets.expr: max by (host, device) (smartctl_device_percentage_used{host=~"$host"}) or (100 - min by (host, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Percent_Lifetime_Remain|Wear_Leveling_Count|Media_Wearout_Indicator", attribute_value_type="value", host=~"$host"}))

max by (host, device) (smartctl_device_media_errors{host=~"$host"}) or sum by (host, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Reported_Uncorrect|Current_Pending_Sector|Offline_Uncorrectable", attribute_value_type="raw", host=~"$host"})

max by (host, device) (smartctl_device_percentage_used{host=~"$host"}) or (100 - min by (host, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{attribute_name=~"Percent_Lifetime_Remain|Wear_Leveling_Count|Media_Wearout_Indicator", attribute_value_type="value", host=~"$host"}))
